issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant duplicated across Python and TypeScript instead of single source.
issues.detail: The string 'python:3.12' now lives in pipeline.py, the jinja template fallback chain, Commands.ts error fallback, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx. The whole RPC round-trip exists to centralize this, yet four hardcoded copies remain. Data dominates: one constant, fetched once, threaded through. Delete the TS literals and let the empty-string fallback render '(loading)' or block until the RPC returns.

issues.description: Changing empty-string base_image to a hardcoded default silently breaks kfp's own default resolution.
issues.detail: pipeline.py line 145 previously set base_image='' specifically so kfp_dsl would apply its own default. Replacing '' with 'python:3.12' overrides kfp's default behavior for every user who relied on it. The comment above the line still says 'Use kfp default image' but the code no longer does. Either restore '' or delete the misleading comment and document the behavior change.

issues.description: Replacing a one-line Input field with a Button+Dialog is more framework, not more clarity.
issues.detail: The previous code was a single Input bound to updateBaseImage. The new code adds Dialog/DialogTitle/DialogContent/DialogActions, a toggle handler, a new state field, and a modal lifecycle, all to show one default value as helper text. A placeholder or adjacent label on the original Input would have done the same job in zero new components. TOO-MUCH-FRAMEWORK.

issues.description: Three-level prop drilling for defaultBaseImage when one context or fetch-at-leaf would do.
issues.detail: defaultBaseImage now flows LeftPanel -> InlineCellsMetadata -> InlineMetadata and CellMetadataEditor, with pipelineBaseImage riding the same path. Each hop adds an optional prop, a default, and a fallback chain ending in another hardcoded literal. A small context (already used for CellMetadata) or a single fetch inside the editor would collapse this. WRONG-DATA-STRUCTURE for the flow.

issues.description: The fallback chain 'baseImage || pipelineBaseImage || defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' is repeated and inconsistent.
issues.detail: Same chain appears in InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, the Dialog placeholder, and the jinja template (in a different order). When ordering or precedence changes, four sites must move in lockstep. Compute the effective image once at one boundary (server side, in compiler.py) and pass a single resolved value down. Filter shape: resolve -> render.

issues.description: Button labeled 'IMAGE' with width 5% inside a 'padding: 0' div is a UX and layout smell.
issues.detail: Width 5% will not fit the word IMAGE at most viewport widths; the inline styles compete with MUI Button sizing. The old Input at width 25% was self-describing. If a Button is truly needed, label it 'Edit Base Image' and let MUI size it. Cleverness audit: the compact button is not load-bearing.

review.summary: This PR adds a sensible feature (surface the default base image in the UI) but pays for it with duplicated constants, prop drilling, and a Dialog where an Input already worked. The data structure question Pike asks is: where does 'the effective base image' live? Right now it lives in four places (Python constant, jinja fallback, TS Commands fallback, TS Editor constant) and is recomputed via a four-term OR chain at every render site. Resolve it once on the server and ship one string. Also: the pipeline.py change from '' to 'python:3.12' silently overrides kfp's own default and contradicts the comment above it. Strip the duplication, keep the RPC, simplify the UI back toward the original Input.
